responsibility: Contains the FT32 RTL machine description that maps generic GCC RTL operations onto FT32 instructions and expanders. It includes the backend’s instruction patterns for arithmetic, logic, moves, shifts, branches, switch dispatch, atomic exchange, string/memory operations, and prologue/epilogue support, along with FT32 unspec codes, register constants, alternatives, output templates, and small expanders that call C helpers in ft32.cc. This is the primary instruction-selection and assembly-emission specification for the FT32 port.
same_name_distinction: Unlike ft32.h’s compile-time target macros, ft32.cc’s C++ hook code, and ft32.opt’s switch definitions, this machine-description file is the declarative RTL pattern table that maps GCC operations to FT32 instructions, including insn definitions, expanders, constraints/predicates usage, and prologue/epilogue patterns that call helpers in ft32.cc.
